about.title: About
about.name: Guillaume Verbiguié
about.lead: I am building a public lab for intelligent systems — from data to agents, toward physical AI.
intro: Since 2014 I have worked as a Data Analyst, Data Scientist and then Senior Data Analyst: banking, retail, research, public sector. The chain is always the same — understand the need, prepare the data, analyse, deliver — with machine learning when there is a case.

I am currently Senior Data Analyst at AdvanThink, on data projects for public organisations including the Ministries of the Interior and Labor. Before that, four and a half years at Ipsos, where I coordinated 2–3 people (juniors / apprentices). Since 2021 I have been mentoring data students at OpenClassrooms, in parallel with employment.
This Lab is where the next chapter is public: copilots, RAG, measurable watch, and Physical AI as a direction seen from data.
foundation: Since 2014: Data Analyst / Data Scientist / Senior Data Analyst — public sector, banking, retail, research.
End to end: requirements, ETL / preparation, analysis, machine learning where relevant, dashboards and restitution.
Data Strategy, Data Management, Data Governance, Data Culture.
Tools actually used: Python, SQL, Power BI — the rest is on each role.
about.now: A bilingual system to observe, learn, experiment and build. SignalLab already feeds Observe with raw metrics. Decision Copilot and Knowledge Copilot are the first public agentic systems. The rest is being written here.

trajectory.text: Public data-engineering projects — Spark/S3 data lake, Redshift warehouse. Start of OpenClassrooms mentoring.
On-chain analytics: CSV dashboard, anomaly detection, MLflow.
Agentic copilots, grounded RAG, and this Lab.
